prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ANIMOL SOUTH-facing chick nest-return animation sprite sheet.
Input image is character identity reference: match that exact small bright yellow angular chick, cream side wing tips, orange triangular beak and feet, black navy outlines, black eyes with tiny white highlights, and a little three-pronged crown tuft.
Primary request: SIX consecutive poses of the SAME chick facing DOWN / SOUTH / TOWARD CAMERA as it makes a small hop into its straw nest and settles. Chick ONLY, no nest in this sheet.
Layout exact 3 columns x 2 rows, read left-to-right top then bottom. All six same apparent head/body scale, same fixed camera. Transparent gutters and true transparent background; NO black or colored backdrop, no glow or ground shadow.
Pose0: anticipation, little crouch, feet planted, wings tucked, eyes open.
Pose1: takeoff, legs pushing down, wings opening, eyes open.
Pose2: airborne happy hop, body upright, wings out, both feet tucked slightly; keep actual chick size, do not draw its flight height as blank space.
Pose3: soft landing, feet contact and body gently compressed; big visible face.
Pose4: settling into nest, lower body resting, wings folding close, feet tucked.
Pose5: content seated/resting chick, both eyes softly CLOSED as bold short curved lines, orange beak visible, feet mostly tucked, cream wing tips still visible. A clearly recognizable living chick, not a yellow ball.
Style: clean faceted flat cel shades, bold angular navy silhouette, simple large color masses, same view and palette as reference. No red comb, no adult chicken, no human arms, no props, no duplicate chicks inside a cell. Do not include motion arrows, text, icons, nest, or stars. Every sprite isolated and aligned consistently.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ANIMOL EAST-facing chick nest-return animation sprite sheet.
Input1 is existing character identity/direction sheet; input2 is approved new SOUTH return motion and line/color style.
Create exactly SIX consecutive poses of the SAME yellow chick in true RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, orange triangular beak points RIGHT, one visible black eye with white highlight, cream near wing, far eye hidden. Preserve the original identity and faceted angular head tuft; no red comb.
Grid: 3 columns by 2 rows, equal rectangular cells, left-to-right then next row, all six SAME CHARACTER SCALE and fixed camera, transparent gutters and true alpha background. No ground/no cast shadow/no glow.
0 crouch before hop, feet planted, wing folded.
1 takeoff, feet extending, cream wing lifted.
2 small airborne hop, wing out, both feet tucked a little; the beak STILL points RIGHT.
3 soft landing and gentle body compression, eye open, facing right.
4 settle lower and fold the near wing close; feet tucked.
5 comfortable seated/resting SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, visible eye CLOSED in a small smiling curve, beak clearly visible, cream wing tips folded. Not a round generic duck.
Clean large cel color masses, bright yellow/gold, cream wing, orange feet/beak, bold near-black NAVY outlines and same lighting upper-left. Do not turn toward camera, do not show a front face. No nest, no text, no labels, no arrows, no FX, no extra chicks. Six isolated consistent sprites only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ANIMOL NORTH-facing BACK VIEW chick nest-return animation sheet.
Input1 contains the original chick including its NORTH row, input2 is the new return motion/palette reference.
Exactly SIX poses of the same bright yellow chick seen STRICTLY FROM BEHIND facing UP / NORTH, camera overhead/front-centered. NO FACE, NO EYES, NO BEAK visible from behind. Match its three-pronged small crown tuft, angular yellow back/head, two cream side wing tips, orange feet. Strong dark navy outline and clean angular flat gold/cream cel shapes, light upper-left.
Layout: 3 columns x 2 rows, read left-right top then bottom. Uniform CHARACTER SCALE and consistent camera. True transparent background and wide clear gutters, no glow, no ground/shadow.
0 crouched anticipation, both orange feet visible below the back.
1 takeoff, cream wings lifting slightly and legs pushing down.
2 airborne little hop, both cream wings spread, feet tucked a little under the yellow back.
3 soft landing, body gently squashed, feet contact.
4 settling down, wings folding closely, body resting low.
5 comfortably seated in a nest, back view still facing NORTH, feet tucked, cream wing tips snug to body. The chick must remain recognizable and have the SAME head tuft, not turn around.
No nest, no props, no text, no symbols or arrows, no stars, no motion trails. Only the six isolated matching chick sprites. Preserve yellow animal identity.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ANIMOL WEST-facing chick nest-return animation sprite sheet.
Input1 existing chick identity/direction sheet; input2 new right-facing hop and settle animation style.
Create exactly SIX matching animation poses of the SAME yellow chick seen in true LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE. Beak points LEFT in all six, single visible eye on the left-facing side with white highlight, far eye completely hidden. Cream near wing lies on screen RIGHT side of the body. Keep upper-left lighting natural to the original art, do not simply mirror the entire sheet.
Layout 3 columns x 2 rows, left-right top then bottom, same character/head scale and fixed camera, separate transparent gutters. True transparent alpha background, no backdrop/no glow/no shadow.
0 crouch ready to hop, feet planted, wing folded.
1 takeoff, legs extending and wing rising.
2 small happy airborne hop, cream wing spread, both feet lightly tucked.
3 gentle landing, body compressed, eye open.
4 lowering into seated position, wing folds and feet tuck.
5 comfortable seated/resting LEFT profile, visible eye softly CLOSED in curved smiling line, beak stays visible, feet tucked. Same yellow angular chick with little crown tuft, not a duck or an adult hen.
Style must match references exactly: angular simple color shapes, flat gold/bright yellow body, cream wing, orange feet and beak, crisp thick deep navy outlines, no extra texture. No nest, no text or labels, no arrows, symbols, FX, or extra objects; only six aligned isolated chick sprites.

postprocessing: Native RGBA part extraction, one uniform scale per direction, frame registration and compositing with the byte-preserved existing nest; fixed front-rim occlusion and existing completion glints. No painted or procedurally synthesized sprite art.
